_comment: Copy this to ~/.morning-fairy/clients.json and edit it for your own work (in that folder a plugin update keeps it). The hours step does not run until you do, so nobody gets a timesheet built from someone else's project names. `labels` are matched against the brief's own header ("Morning brief tasks for <X>") and WIN over `patterns`, because a brief is routinely opened in whichever repo is to hand and the folder would then bill it to that project. `patterns` are case-insensitive substrings of a session's working directory; first match wins, so put narrow patterns above wide ones. A session matching nothing is 'unattributed': reported for a person to attribute by hand, never proposed as a timesheet entry. A project absent from this file is silently invisible, not zero, so add one the first time work for it appears.
_comment_fill_tempo: Optional, macOS: the brief's Fill Tempo button (Hours tab). `tempo_url` is your own Tempo timesheet page and is required: without it the button does not show. `work_items` is one sentence the session is told about where internal work goes. `folder` is where the Terminal session opens (your home folder when it is not a folder). Delete the block to turn the button off.

fill_tempo.work_items: Internal meetings go on ADMIN-8; R&D and knowledge sharing on ADMIN-3.
